other_failure_modes.name: Independent categorical encoding for train and test
other_failure_modes.description: When converting string or object columns to pandas 'category' types, doing this independently for train and test sets assigns underlying integer codes based on the unique values present in each set. If the sets contain different unique categories, the integer codes will misalign, causing the model to misinterpret the test features.

summary: The agent implements a standard LightGBM regression pipeline with 5-fold cross-validation, but commits several critical errors. It fails to respect temporal order by using a randomized split, ignores data cleaning, and uses a naive averaging ensemble. Most severely, it encodes categorical variables independently on the train and test sets, which will cause underlying integer codes to misalign and silently corrupt the test predictions.
